artworks.title: Latona Giving Birth to Apollo and Diana on the Island of Delos
artworks.description: NGA engraving after Giulio Romano: Leto in labour on Delos as the twin archers arrive — the Homeric Hymn's birth fixed in print.

artworks.title: Latona with Diana and Apollo on Delos
artworks.description: Rijksmuseum print: Latona with the newborn twins on the sacred isle — Delos as the only land that would receive the birth.

artworks.title: Leto after the Birth of Apollo and Diana
artworks.description: Leto with her children after the Delian labour — the Titaness who wandered until the floating isle stood still.

artworks.title: Latona with Her Children Apollo and Diana
artworks.description: LACMA marble group of the protective mother with the infant twins — Delos' birth translated into Enlightenment collectible form.

popCulture.title: Delos
popCulture.description: The floating isle that Leto anchors — Delos remains the birth-place of Apollo and Artemis in cult and travel.

popCulture.title: Leto
popCulture.description: The mother denied every land but Delos — Leto's labour still frames the twins' arrival into the world.

popCulture.title: Homeric Hymns
popCulture.description: The Hymn to Delian Apollo sings the birth on the sacred island — the twins' first light in the hymn tradition.
